newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 50,000t, Sept 16-20 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 50,000t, Sept 16-20 fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy an additional of 50,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery in September, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 25,000 tonnes of 3.5 percent sulphur, 180 centistoke fuel oil for delivery to Goa/Kandla and another 25,000 tonnes to Vizag/Haldia.
The cargoes are to be delivered September 16-20.
The tender will close September 5 and offers should be valid for one day.
IOC issued a tender on Monday to buy 25,000 tonnes of similar grade fuel oil for September 11-15 delivery to Goa/Kandla. The tender will close on August 29 and is valid until August 30.
